loaddata: uv run python app/manage.py loaddata sample_ores sample_components sample_blocks
docker-migrate: docker compose exec web python app/manage.py migrate
docker-shell: docker compose exec web python app/manage.py shell
docker-db: docker compose exec database psql -U se2_user -d se2_calculator
check-all: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest --cov
